title: Community Schedule of Deferment Agreement Charges — Home Purchase Financing
content:
**Community fee schedule — the deferment agreement charge on Home Purchase Financing loans**

The deferment agreement charge is the amount charged for the agreement itself within the deferment fee, to which the deferral charge is added. It is chosen by the community the financed home's site lies in, as the borrower's Home-Site Lease for that site shows.

Where the home's site is in Willow Bend Estates or Palmetto Shores, the Florida communities, the deferment agreement charge is 30.00; where it is in Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows, the deferment agreement charge is 25.00. For a site in any other community no community agreement charge is set by this schedule.

| Community of the financed home's site (from the Home-Site Lease) | Deferment agreement charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| Willow Bend Estates | 30.00 |
| Palmetto Shores | 30.00 |
| Cedar Hollow | 25.00 |
| Conestoga Meadows | 25.00 |
| any other community | not set by this schedule |

*Hypothetical cases.* A borrower whose financed home sits in Palmetto Shores has a deferment agreement charge of 30.00 whatever the program; one whose home sits in Conestoga Meadows, 25.00. The community is taken from the lease of the financed home's site, not from the borrower's mailing address.
